name: official-tool-sync
description: Compare installed Arisa tools with the official catalog, detect local divergence, and safely stage, validate, back up, and apply official updates without overwriting tool configuration.

minimumFreeBytes.prompt: Free bytes that must remain while cloning and staging updates.

maxFilesystemUsagePercent.prompt: Maximum projected filesystem usage allowed while staging an update.

stagingHeadroomBytes.prompt: Additional staging allowance for dependency installation.

commandTimeoutMs.prompt: Timeout for Git, dependency installation, and validation commands.

protectedFiles.prompt: Tool-relative files that official updates must never overwrite.
